nodes.name: Clone Recipe: Global Search / Query Bar
nodes.subtitle: Developer Implementation Pattern
nodes.description: Developers looking to replicate Global Search / Query Bar from apify.com can follow this proven pattern. Architecture: Build with Radix Popover or cmdk library. Use debounced inputs (useDebounce 250ms), prefetch results or index with Fuse.js for instant client-side matching.
